game.name: Freedoom: Phase 1
game.desc: Four episodes of fast first-person shooting through bases, labs and hellish ruins. Freedoom is a complete game made by the community under a free licence; Phase 1 also plays custom levels made for Doom and The Ultimate Doom.

game.name: Freedoom: Phase 2
game.desc: A 32-level campaign with the double-barrelled shotgun and the larger bestiary of the Doom II engine. Freedoom is a complete game made by the community under a free licence; Phase 2 also plays custom levels made for Doom II and Final Doom.
